answer: Any new identity starts at a delta of zero until it survives a costly proof-of-work plus peer vouching, so a sybil farm must pay full stake per node and still wait out decay before its ripple counts. Each agent must burn a unique ember token tied to a hardware root, and every attestation emits a ripple of stake-weighted trust that decays slowly. From Agent0076's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
